item.title: docs: operator UX decisions 2026-10-28
item.body:
Direct-PR: operator UX decisions

Not a lot: records the operator's UX decisions of 2026-10-28 and plans the lots they create (issues already open).

**Problem.** The MVP renders look zoomed in, the app dropped the legacy bottom bar and puts Drapeaux/Favoris on top of the forum list, group MPs cannot be told apart, and the About links had no rule. None of this was written down, and #286 had no row.

**What changed, and why this wide.**
- `docs/FEATURES.md`: new "UX principles (operator)" section (preserve the legacy navigation, dense display with a text-size slider, legacy defaults with opt-in changes, HFR links open in the app); FEAT-001 becomes opt-in only (needs community support); FEAT-010's compact mode points to LOT-169. README map row updated (FEATURES.md now holds the principles; no new document).
- `docs/lots/LOT-082-adaptive-navigation.md`: the split-view-only navigation is recorded as reverted on purpose (LOT-170).
- `docs/LOTS.md`: rows LOT-168 (#286), LOT-169 (#295, text size and density, high), LOT-170 (#296, legacy bottom bar, high), LOT-171 (#297, MP / group MP lists); LOT-106 hands text size to LOT-169; LOT-120 depends on LOT-095 (About links open in the app); the parity gate LOT-164 waits for 169 and 170; capture backlog gains #285, #287–#290 and #298.

Issue comments with the decisions and acceptance criteria: #210, #197, #154, #145, #233, #234, #217, #211, #254, #215, #208, #178, #243, #286; PR #292.

**Checks.** `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py`: 151 lots, 0 violations; `scripts/tests` pass. Markdown lint runs in CI.
